quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing results presentation: First Three Months of Fiscal Year 2026 (Ending March 31, 2027) Briefing Materials (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: First quarter (April-June 2026) of the fiscal year ending March 2027 (results deck): sales JPY 372.9 billion (+1.9% YoY from JPY 366.1 billion), operating profit JPY 27.8 billion (+21.3% from JPY 22.9 billion), ordinary profit JPY 35.2 billion (+25.0%), net profit attributable to parent company shareholders JPY 23.5 billion (-48.0%) on lower gains on sales of investment securities, but in line with the initial full-year forecast; progress against the full-year forecast 24.4% for sales and 25.8% for operating profit. Capex JPY 14.8 billion (+3.0%), R&D JPY 9.9 billion (-1.2%), depreciation JPY 12.9 billion (+14.8%); exchange rate JPY160/$ vs JPY145/$ a year earlier. The company says focus-business profit rose slightly as strong semiconductor-related businesses offset lower sales of OLED metal masks and IT-device battery pouches caused by memory-semiconductor shortages, and restructuring kept lifting stable / reforming businesses; the Middle East impact on Q1 operating profit was minimal after it adopted alternative materials, widened its supplier base and passed higher costs on to customers.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 sales JPY 372.9 billion (+1.9%); operating profit JPY 27.8 billion (+21.3%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing results presentation: First Three Months of Fiscal Year 2026 (Ending March 31, 2027) Briefing Materials (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics, Q1 to June 2026 (results deck): sales JPY 71.3 billion (+12.4% YoY from JPY 63.4 billion), operating profit JPY 17.8 billion (+28.2% from JPY 13.9 billion). Semiconductor (front-end): profit increased as sales of photomasks for semiconductor manufacturing grew for advanced products and remained solid for the volume zone, giving YoY sales growth. Digital Interface: sales rose as display optical films stayed solid on larger shipment area from bigger LCD TV panels and the newly installed ultra-wide coating line at Mihara Plant (Hiroshima), but profit declined as OLED metal masks were affected by reduced output of mid-range and entry-level smartphones due to memory shortages, although metal-mask sales for high-end applications increased.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics Q1 sales JPY 71.3 billion (+12.4%); operating profit JPY 17.8 billion (+28.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing results presentation: First Three Months of Fiscal Year 2026 (Ending March 31, 2027) Briefing Materials (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, Q1 to June 2026 (results deck): Smart Communication sales JPY 173.9 billion (-1.4%), operating profit JPY 5.1 billion (-13.9%) - information security fell on lower dual-interface smart-card sales and higher goodwill amortisation while BPO stayed solid; photo-related materials were strong in Europe, North America and Asia and photography services grew; publishing improved through library management services and structural reforms. Life & Healthcare sales JPY 127.7 billion (+0.5%), operating profit JPY 11.5 billion (+21.8%) - battery pouches for IT devices fell on mobile-device weakness caused by memory shortages, solar-cell encapsulants were strong on growing interest in solar power amid a sharp rise in electricity demand from data centers, packaging profit grew on stable raw-material procurement, price pass-through and productivity, and automotive decorative films and Artellion aluminium panels were steady. DNP plans to acquire 100% of Kyowa Pharma and make it a consolidated subsidiary in October 2026 to expand medical and healthcare operations.
quarterly_data.figure: Smart Communication Q1 operating profit JPY 5.1 billion (-13.9%); Life & Healthcare JPY 11.5 billion (+21.8%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing results presentation: First Three Months of Fiscal Year 2026 (Ending March 31, 2027) Briefing Materials (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Full-year forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 (DNP's 'FY2026') unchanged (results deck): sales JPY 1,530.0 billion (+1.2% from JPY 1,512.5 billion), operating profit JPY 108.0 billion (+6.9% from JPY 101.0 billion; margin 7.1% vs 6.7%), ordinary profit JPY 124.0 billion (+4.0%), net profit attributable to parent company shareholders JPY 95.0 billion (-8.6%), ROE 8.0%; capex JPY 77.0 billion (-12.2%), R&D JPY 43.0 billion (+1.7%), depreciation JPY 57.0 billion (+7.9%). By segment (sales / operating profit): Smart Communication JPY 742.0 billion / JPY 43.0 billion; Life & Healthcare JPY 516.0 billion / JPY 39.0 billion; Electronics JPY 274.0 billion (+JPY 22.2 billion from JPY 251.8 billion) / JPY 54.0 billion (+JPY 3.3 billion). The May forecast had assumed a JPY2.0 billion Middle East hit in Q1, but the actual Q1 impact was minimal; the forecast now incorporates an estimated JPY2.0 billion negative impact for Q2-Q4. The year-on-year special factors in the forecast are +JPY10.2 billion from retirement benefits and -JPY2.0 billion from the Middle East.
